description: The official industrial electronic and tactical chiptune soundtrack for Hunker Bunker, composed by Government Name.

tracks.title: Hunker Bunker Main Theme
tracks.description: The primary tactical theme greeting operators at the entrance of the deep bio-vaults.

tracks.title: Safe Haven (Ship Sanctuary)
tracks.description: Warm ambient sanctuary vibes heard inside the player's recovery vessel.

tracks.title: Glacial Depths (Cryo Biome)
tracks.description: Cold, isolating resonant pads echo through the frozen sub-sectors.

tracks.title: Overgrown Bio-Sphere (Bio Biome)
tracks.description: Organic clicks and unsettling synthesizer sweeps inside the flora sectors.

tracks.title: Under Siege (Combat Alert)
tracks.description: Fast-paced tension driving operators during close-quarters hostile encounters.
